hits.draft_en:
OpenAI says people should always stay in control of the future.

Good principle, and you can ship a tiny version of it today.

Before a Copilot Studio agent sends, deletes or spends anything, put a human approval step in front of it. One extra click, and you still get to say no.

hits.hook: OpenAIDevs: Pando, a new Git backend for the monorepo, ~80% lower push latency, nearly a petabyte of Git data a day (carried over, was 1.19M)
hits.text:

hits.name: OpenAI
hits.hook: OpenAI plans an internal security sprint with Cathedral Systems: defenders should put AI to work first (carried over, was 669K)
hits.text:
As AI becomes more capable at finding vulnerabilities, defenders need to put it to work before attackers do.

We’re planning our next internal security sprint at OpenAI and partnering with Cathedral Systems, whose researchers will use our models alongside our teams to challenge our defenses. They’ll bring differentiated expertise and approaches to our ongoing work to find and fix weaknesses with AI.

We’re also raising bug bounty rewards, including more than quadrupling rewards for critical findings. Exceptional findings will be eligible for up to $172,000, including bonuses.

We’ll keep advancing our models, using them to strengthen our own systems, and expanding access for trusted defenders.

https://t.co/vcaoHROTt2

hits.name: OpenAI Newsroom
hits.hook: OpenAI will acquire Pierre to make Codex a place where teams build software together with AI
hits.text:
Today we’re announcing that OpenAI will acquire @pierrecomputer to accelerate our vision for making Codex a place where teams can build software together with AI, from first idea to the version they ship.

Pierre’s open-source developer tools already power parts of Codex today.
hits.original:
Today we’re announcing that OpenAI will acquire @pierrecomputer to accelerate our vision for making Codex a place where teams can build software together with AI, from first idea to the version they ship.

Pierre’s open-source developer tools already power parts of Codex today.
hits.draft_en:
OpenAI is buying Pierre so teams can build software together with AI in Codex, and Pierre's open-source dev tools already power parts of Codex.

The interesting part is the word together.

Solo AI is the demo. Shared AI, where a team can see, review and build on the same thing, is the actual job. Same test for your Copilot Studio agents: can a teammate pick it up on Monday?
hits.video_tip: Vertical 20s: two avatars editing the same agent, one comment thread appears, then a 'handed over' badge. Caption: 'Can a teammate pick this up on Monday?'

drafts.text:
OpenAI says people should always stay in control of the future.

Good principle, and you can ship a tiny version of it today.

Before a Copilot Studio agent sends, deletes or spends anything, put a human approval step in front of it. One extra click, and you still get to say no.
drafts.video_tip: Talking head 15s: 'Agents propose, people approve.' Cut to a Copilot Studio flow where an Approve / Reject card pops up in Teams before the agent's final action runs.

drafts.text:
ChatGPT and Codex are now helping with mechanical design, electrical engineering and simulation.

Hard to call that a chatbot.

Your Copilot Studio agent shouldn't be one either. Give it a job, a trigger and a hand-off, not just a chat box and good vibes.
drafts.video_tip: Screen recording 20s: left side a plain chat window, right side the same agent with a trigger, an action and a hand-off to a person. Caption: 'Chat box vs job description'.

drafts.text:
OpenAI is buying Pierre so teams can build software together with AI in Codex, and Pierre's open-source dev tools already power parts of Codex.

The interesting part is the word together.

Solo AI is the demo. Shared AI, where a team can see, review and build on the same thing, is the actual job. Same test for your Copilot Studio agents: can a teammate pick it up on Monday?
drafts.video_tip: Vertical 20s: two avatars editing the same agent, one comment thread appears, then a 'handed over' badge. Caption: 'Can a teammate pick this up on Monday?'

drafts.text:
Tired of waiting on my manager's approval, so I vibed a way better approval app.

It stores everything in a SharePoint list. Check it out - localhost:3000.

Works perfectly. On my machine. Please don't ask me to deploy it.
drafts.video_tip: Meme format 10s: confident screen recording of a slick approval app, then a zoom on the address bar showing localhost:3000. Hard cut to a shrug. Add the caption 'works on my machine'.

drafts.text:
Copilot Autopilot is scheduled to start rolling out to Frontier this month. Its own account, its own computer, and it keeps working while you're offline.

So the real question: what do you hand it first?

My shortlist: the weekly Excel cleanup, the 3am failed-flow triage, and the status report nobody wants to write.
